page.layout: One column of running text, with a catchword at the lower right. Left and right edges carry scan fragments and stains, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: oppida potestatis suæ fecille. Theodosii istius primi ex filioArcadio nepos Theodosius alter imperator à morte patris diligenti cura sororis Pulcheriæ bonis literis probè imbutus uxorem accepit Eudociam fœminam doctissimam, civem Atticam Leontii philosophi filiam, quæ eruditi ingenii sui monumenta post se reliquisse traditur: cujus fratres duo Valerius & Genesius magnis rei publicæ negociis ab imperatore marito fuêre præfecti. Ex hac nata fuit marito filia unica matri cognominis, nupta Valentiniano III imperatori: cui peperit Placidiam filiam Olybrii imperatoris conjugem, Eudociam nuptam Thrasymundo Vandalorum regi, filio Genserici, patri Honorici. Et post aliquot ætates Athenis Attico cive genita Irene Leoni IIII imperatori uxor data, magis magni quàm boni nominis imperatrix, Carolo Magno Francorum regi, & Romanorum in occidente imperatori coæva, statuarum cultrix & propugnatrix singularis, fœmina ambitiosissima, & turbulenti animi, quæ multos motus in imperio excitavit, filium unicum Constantinum Porphyrogenitum oculis privavit atque imperio exuit, imperium ipsa rapuit: quod cum aliquandiu æquiter[?] gessisset, à Nicephoro Logo-

page.notes: Left edge: partial marks "at" and "si" cut by the scan edge, and a small red mark, appear to belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Bottom left: a stray "E" with a cross-like mark, probably a signature or stain; not transcribed. The word "æquiter" is partly obscured at its first letter. Roman numerals are copied as printed in lowercase form and given in capitals: III, IIII. Long s is normalised to s. The paragraph continues onto the next page and ends with the printed hyphen of "Logo-", with the catchword "theta" below.
